note: Druid facing front in a green hooded cloak. Hood, hair and beard are head; beard bottom y~482 at centre, rising to y~430 at the sides. The cloak/cowl around the neck, the tunic, belt, baldric strap and tunic skirt are torso; the tunic hem (wavy, y~800-815) is the hip, y~808. Both upper arms are hidden under the cloak, so no upper-arm labels; the bare forearms emerge from it: left forearm is the narrow skin strip (x332-384, y552-632), right forearm skin y~560-634. Left wrist: where the green glove (cuff and fist gripping the staff) begins, about the line from (358,580) to (360,640). Right wrist y~634: the green glove cuff with the stud and the fist below it are hand (y634-770). No bend marks the knees; the bare/olive band between hem and boot cuffs is thigh and the boot cuffs and shafts are lower leg, so knees are at the boot cuff tops y~826. Ankles at the instep (left y~892, right y~888). Equipment: the wooden staff (knobbly top above the left fist and shaft below), with the white cloth/feather tied to it.
